mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_log (user_id, username, phone, question, answer, from_knowledge, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, conversation_id, agent_action, card_data) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{phone}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{fromKnowledge}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{conversationId}, #{agentAction}, #{cardData})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, username, phone, question, answer, from_knowledge AS fromKnowledge, model, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, conversation_id AS conversationId, agent_action AS agentAction, card_data AS cardData, created_at AS createdAt FROM ai_chat_log WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_log WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, username, phone, question, answer, from_knowledge AS fromKnowledge, model, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, created_at AS createdAt FROM ai_chat_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT acl.user_id) FROM ai_chat_log acl
acl.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_log WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_log acl INNER JOIN sys_user su ON acl.user_id = su.id SET acl.phone = su.phone WHERE acl.phone IS NULL OR acl.phone = ''
UPDATE ai_chat_log acl INNER JOIN sys_user su ON acl.user_id = su.id SET acl.username = su.name WHERE acl.username IS NULL OR acl.username = ''
